text:
Our field sales team piloted an AI note-taker for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-call admin from 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time, not just tidier CRMs.

**2. Data got better.** Notes were consistent, so pipeline reviews finally compared like with like.

**3. Trust took work.** Some buyers hesitated on recording. Reps who asked permission upfront and explained the "why" saw almost no pushback.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what mattered. Managers still had to coach on the read between the lines.

**5. Adoption followed habit.** Teams that reviewed notes in weekly huddles stuck with it. Others drifted.

Net result: worth scaling, with guardrails.

What's your team's experience with AI note-takers?
